title: Mt Martha South Beach Market
summary: Public-holiday street food and makers market on the lawn at Mt Martha House, 60+ stalls and food vans with the bay laid out below.
recurrenceNote: Victorian public holidays only (irregular; check website)
accessibilityNotes: Hilltop lawn; some gentle slopes; prams generally manageable
nearbyAttractions: Mount Martha beach; The Briars; Mornington
suggestedItineraryPairing: Public holiday outing – market + beach + dining
editorVerdict: The view does most of the work, the stalls do the rest. A reliable public-holiday morning when the timing lines up.
editorNote:
Mt Martha South Beach Market sits on the lawn at Mt Martha House with one of the better bay views on the Peninsula. 60+ stalls leaning boutique (fashion, ceramics, homewares, pet bits), a handful of food vans, and a pace that suits a leisurely loop rather than a hit-and-run.

The catch: it only runs on Victorian public holidays, so plan around the calendar. King's Birthday in June is the next one. Arrive on the early side, do a lap with a coffee, then walk the path down to South Beach for a swim or a stroll.

Not the market to drive an hour for if you're chasing volume or produce. The right call if you're already in Mount Martha for the long weekend.
